title: The existing point-ideal divisor-class equivalence
statement: Let k be a field and C a Noetherian integral curve over k, with structure morphism smooth of relative dimension one. The homomorphism Divisor.toPic k C factors through an additive equivalence e : Cl(C) ≃+ Additive Pic(C), with e([D]) = Divisor.toPic k C D for every D. This uses the point-ideal construction, without any assertion about the explicit valuation-bounded module.

source.place: exists_divisorClassGroup_addEquiv_pic, its complete proof and docstring

proof.text: Use the already implemented theorem exists_divisorClassGroup_addEquiv_pic in Curve.Picard. Its proof computes the kernel of Divisor.toPic as principalDivisors using the positive and negative parts of D and the two ideal-sheaf comparison theorems nonempty_toModules_idealSheaf_iso_of_ord_eq and exists_ord_eq_of_nonempty_iso.

The same implementation proves surjectivity using Modules.exists_nonempty_iso_dual_toModules_idealSheaf_tensorObj, then applies QuotientAddGroup.quotientAddEquivOfEq and quotientKerEquivOfSurjective. On a divisor the quotient equivalence computes to Divisor.toPic by reflexivity. The entire implementation is already present, and is not restated in a new Lean module.
